nodes.label: naturalizedRules Catalog (dcmjs/schema, normative)
nodes.rationale: One machine-readable source of truth for the naturalized representation; the rule catalog is normative and the TypeScript and JSON-Schema documents are generated from it so they cannot drift. dictionaryHash ties the artifact to the exact dictionary edition. CI enforces freshness/determinism, type correctness, and code agreement against NaturalizedListener output over the full fixture corpus.

nodes.label: TypeScript Projection (types/dcmjs-schema.d.ts, NaturalizedDataset)
nodes.rationale: Types the naturalized data shape only, not the dcmjs API — which is why it ships as the dcmjs/schema subpath rather than a top-level types field. 64-bit integers type as number|string so precision is never silently lost.

nodes.label: JSON-Schema Projection (naturalized.schema.json)
nodes.rationale: A projection for ecosystem tooling (Ajv etc.); streaming element-by-element validation consumes the catalog directly because JSON Schema cannot express DICOM VM patterns like 3-3n or original-encoding length caps. x-dicom-vr/vm/tag annotations carry what JSON Schema cannot.
